info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Payments-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payments Retrieval API enables consumers to access a comprehensive list of billing payments associated with utility accounts. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of payment data, supporting account auditing and financial analysis processes. Typical users include utility company staff and financial analysts who require insights into payment histories and trends. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer interactions and streamline their billing reconciliation efforts.

get.description: Fetches the payment details associated with billing, allowing users to view their payment histories and statuses. This endpoint provides critical information for managing billing and payments efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing payment information. This body should contain the necessary parameters to specify the payment details required for the operation.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the billing payment operations GET endpoint.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.title: Billing Payment Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the payment transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the payment processing.

state.description: The current state of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the payment operation.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response format for a successful billing payment operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the payment entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the payment entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment processing was automated.

AuditDetails.description: This schema contains audit information related to the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time (in milliseconds) that the server took to process the request. A lower value represents a faster response time.
